storage.brains.text: Zilandwe kanye, ukuze zisebenze ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi
backup.text: Isipele yifayela elilodwa elinayo yonke imisebenzi namafayela akho. Okhiye bakho abakho neze kulo.
backup.confirmRestore: Engeza konke okusesipeleni? Akukho lapha okuzosuswa.
data.none: Kukhona lapha kuphela: akukho okwenzelwe isipele okwamanje.
data.unkept: Isiphequluli sakho singakusula ukuze senze isikhala.
data.old: Isipele sakho sokugcina: {when}. Okwenzile kusukela lapho kukhona lapha kuphela.
data.privacyLine: Obani abangavula izinto zakho kule divayisi, nokuthi obani ababona lokho owabelana ngakho.
data.peopleText: Abantu obathumelela izinto, nalabo abakuthumelela ezabo
data.of: {size} / {quota}: isikhala lesi siphequluli esivumela umsizi {name} ukuthi asisebenzise
data.readable: Isipele yikhophi efundekayo: yigcine lapho kungavulwa khona nguwe kuphela.
data.import: Letha kusuka ku-ChatGPT, Claude noma Gemini
data.importText: Izingxoxo namaphrojekthi azo kungena kule phrojekthi
data.into: Izingxoxo, amaphrojekthi namafayela azo kungena ephrojekthini {project}. Akukho lapha okususwayo, futhi okukhishiwe okufanayo akungeni kabili.
data.assistants: ChatGPT ne-Claude: kuzilungiselelo zazo, cela ukukhipha idatha yakho. Isixhumanisi sefayela le-.zip sifika nge-imeyili.
data.gemini: Gemini: ku-Google Takeout, khetha i-Gemini, ne-My Activity ene-Gemini Apps kuphela, ku-JSON.
data.private: Ukuze ugcine imisebenzi yakho, vula umsizi {name} ewindini elingesilo eliyimfihlo.
data.forgetText: Umsebenzi ongashintshwanga lutho isikhathi eside kangako uyasuswa unomphela, kule divayisi nasefoldeni evumelanisiwe; ephiniwe iyahlala.
data.forgetConfirm: Imisebenzi engashintshwanga lutho isikhathi esingu: {kept} izosuswa unomphela, manje nsuku zonke. Qhubeka?
